description: Add a hand test to a claimed Goal, such as 'OpenCode may ask permission to read an attached file: allow it and check the reply', and TRY EACH HAND TEST YOURSELF: do it (the dashboard in the browser pane, the tools, the CLI), then mark it with id plus result and a note. Only something that truly needs the Developer (their real accounts, another computer) waits for them. The Developer sees the Goal's hand-test list on the dashboard, with 'Tried by the AI' on yours, and can mark again to replace yours. A failure adds a Task to the Goal by itself (and reopens a finished Goal); a Goal waiting on its tests finishes when the last one is marked. get_status shows what is still open and the Developer's new marks. With id and no result: reword it, change which Task it is about, or remove it with an empty text (for one that turned out not to need testing); its mark stays. With id and result: MARK it as the AI, on any Goal on the plan (claimed or not, and with project in another project's plan); give goal when the test's Goal is not the only one this Session holds. note says what you did and saw; picture is a screenshot file as proof.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

id.description: A hand test's ID, such as 'h2', to change or mark it; leave out to add one.

note.description: With result: what you did and saw, in one or two lines (kept for every result).

picture.description: With result: the path of a screenshot (.png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif) as proof, shown on the hand test.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

result.description: With id: the AI's mark after trying it.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about, such as 't3'; with id, an empty string removes the link.

text.description: What to try and what to look for, in one or two short plain sentences; with id, empty removes it.

name: save_hand_test
title: Save hand test
